integrity: Complete self-contained bounded enumeration with independent geometric and polynomial-root paths and a checked coordinate witness; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact strict projective realization classification only for fields of orders 2,3,4,5,7. No assertion for larger fields or on characteristic-seven K3 special fibers. Priority in unindexed finite-matroid tables remains possible.
title: The first finite field for strict realizations of Schroeter configuration V
